games.name: Wilson's PRISON (SCARY OBBY)
games.desc:
You've just been put in the world's most secure prison meant for only the worst of the worst criminals... Unfortunately for you, the prison has hired Wilson to watch over the inmates. This won't be so easy... LET'S ESCAPE!

⚠️ GAME CONTAINS JUMPSCARES AND LOUD NOISES ⚠️

Finished easy mode? Try hard mode!

Can you escape Wilson and make it to stage 19 of this obby / parkour? He will be chasing you in his multiple forms!

If you had fun I'd be so appreciative if you were to leave a 👍 and favorite, ❤️.

If you're stuck on a stage make sure to check out some of the fun power-ups in the shop, any purchases are greatly appreciated and support me in making future games but don't feel pressured, simply playing the game is just as meaningful to me as a developer ❤️. Have fun!

games.name: 3D Planets Simulator [BETA]
games.desc:
Welcome to 3D Planets Simulator! In this game, you can build a rocket, set up a base, and survive Earth’s death (or not). Alternatively, you can survive a gazillion bugs!!!

No, we're not copying other similar planet games, as we are all fangames of Untitled Planet Game (a sadly deleted and discontinued game). Objects like Humanciperson were given permission by the creator to use in 3PS.

----------------------------------------------------------------------

Try out some of these features in-game:
Colonize your favorite planets! 🪐
Terraform hundreds of objects! 🌳
Industrialize and create giant money-making machines! 💵
Make your own custom ships that you can save and load anywhere you want! 🚀*
Explore over 30 unique systems! ⭐
Interact with aliens! 👽

* Requires save staff, acquired via gamepass or badge.
----------------------------------------------------------------------

Inspired by Untitled Planet Game and Solar System Exploration 2.

Credits found on the main menu.

games.name: PROJECT MONSTER
games.desc:
Project Monster Multiplayer is a game in which you will have to work as a team.

There are 2 game modes:
🤠You are a single player: You will play as a team
👹You are the monster: You must kill the other players

There are 3 game modes:
🎁First Mode: You will have to collect 25 boxes and then escape on the train.
🔫Second Mode: You will have to collect boxes and then throw them at the monster to kill it
💊Third Mode: You will have to collect things to deactivate the machine that wants to revive the monster

Rewards (Emeralds):
💰Chests with Like and Group Member goals
💸Codes on our Fan Page
💎Reviving a player will give you gems
👑Staying until the end of the game will give you gems
